reproduction.method: Bounded seeded Markov traversal versus the exact stationary distribution
reproduction.description: Run 30,000 local hops on the original six-node graph, including teleportation and dangling-node handling.
differences: Uses the original graph and damping 0.85, not generated or recovered web data.
The original exits before its interactive infinite loop; this replacement deliberately enables a finite local simulation.
Shows empirical visits separately from exact PageRank; no animation, network access, or claim that simulation is the production ranking algorithm.

checks.name: Empirical ranking is close to exact stationary distribution
